ops.body: Quiet-machine evidence (2026-07-27 ~04:30): armed watcher probed after the synthetic-load harness was killed; at load ~57 the bridge still failed all 3 probes — probe 1 systemCall(send, errno 32 EPIPE), probes 2-3 "disconnected".
